outcome: Physician practice patterns in VTE prophylaxis during pregnancy and postpartum
cohort: North American physicians experienced in managing thrombophilia in pregnancy
finding: While there was consensus on using prophylactic low-molecular weight heparin (LMWH) for low-risk thrombophilia, variability existed in anticoagulation management for higher risk thrombophilia, during labor induction versus spontaneous labor, and in postpartum prophylaxis duration based on delivery mode.
